body.name: rare-cell experiment class without tuning restrictions
body.construction: \(\mathfrak P_{\kappa}^{0}=\{\mathbb P=(P_n^\circ)_{n\ge1}:\beta_n=(p_n,r_n,\mu_n),\ \min_{c\in\mathcal C}p_{n,c}\wedge\min_{x\in\mathcal X}r_{n,x}\ge\kappa_n,\ \min_{(c,x)\in\mathcal C\times\mathcal X}\pi_{n,cx}\ge\kappa_n\ \forall n\ge1\}\). Within each row, observations are independent, \(\mathcal C\) and \(\mathcal X\) are fixed, and \(\widehat\beta_n\) stacks the margin and response estimators. No condition on \(n\kappa_n^3\) or on \(t\) is part of this class.
